document: DS15137 Rev 2 - Table 66. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI).
title: Table 66. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI).
text_helper: Table 66. IWDG min/max timeout period at 32 kHz (LSI). — section 5.3.23 Timer characteristics. Prescaler divider, PR[2:0] bits, Min timeout RL[11:0] = 0x000, Max timeout RL[11:0] = 0xFFF, Unit.

notes: 1. The minimum SDA data setup time during open-drain-mode is 3 ns, as specified in the MIPI Alliance specification for I3C.
legend: Note: For the values in this table, the exact timings still depend on the phasing of the APB interface clock versus the LSI clock, so that there is
always a full RC period of uncertainty.
